book.name: 1 Ubitru
book.title: Ubvur uwu inggbaashia Ubitru aka atsɛng

content: Nggee, àka atsũwe atsimbi ru ikpũ amɛn aka abewe, ukpukpeta, unyɛ̃ɛ̃ nu urhena ukpu ubɛn ikpũa.
Ru nyaka írheng awɛkaci iki ikponi iyam abɛ̃, Àka akponu ihwɛng Arherhu Unum, ake itsu umbi aseng ri ififɔrhmbi,
icɛrɛ umbi aka abanga agũ ugɛ Uteijee awu azeze.
Utarh urhɛ nu aner umbɔ aka asɛng
Àka aba ru unga, utarh urhɛ ha anera aka akpɛ̃mbɔ, bɔr Unum asɛng ukpɔ uwe ru ugarh ru unga.
Umbi ikɛi, awe ru nyaka atarh, Unum unga awu uner idzin, unga ani ikũ umbi akũ adzin iyanga. Ru ubok Uyesu Ukiristo, umbi awe asarkasar abika idzowe idɛm-Num iyiriyɛ iki itsu Unum agũibɛn.
Itsɛng Arherhu-Num igɔr igɛ,

content.text: utarh ukpuku uwu ru ugarh umbɔ aka asɛng
kishoo uwuku uwe ru imangmang ru unga,

content: Nggee ru umbi abi imangmang, utarh ukpirɛ uwu ru ugarh. Bɔr ra abika asheri imangmang,
Nu,

content.text: nu ifa iki itsu umbɔ agbaigba.>>

content: Unum atsu umbɔ akwɛr itok, ubinkutsu, asi idɔsumbɔ isarhe iyiki ize.

Bɔr umbi awu abirabɛ umbɔ aka asɛng, abika adzowe idɛm-Num ri iya uyɛrhe, asarkasar abĩ, anerabɛ aka awe abi Unum, agɛ umbi ama akũ ikpikpoinga adzeka unga aka ayisa umbi ru uzĩ adzek atsĩ ri idzeu irhirhangnga.
Isha umbi asi iwembi aner Unum, bɔr icɛrɛ umbi awe aner Unum. Isha umbi asi iyɛimbi atorh, bɔr icɛrɛ umbi ayɛimbi atorh.
Àka adɔsa arherha abi ijee
A aze awɛrhamum, umum ifituwa umbi, ru nyaka atsen ru upfung, àka neke idɔsa abin ikponi iyor, aki itang iwa ri ipfumbi.
Àka asei nggu amɛn aka arhurhika ra ateu anera aka asi ihwɛngmbɔ Unum, nggayɛ umbɔ ani irhena umbi, umbɔ ama anyã irhirhikambi na akpoi Unum ru unumkpi unga aka iba ayepa umɛn.
Àka adɔsa arherhe ubɛn abi ijee ri itsi Uteijee, ra ayɛrhe use ubɛn ijee ra anernga kishoo,
use agomna, unga aka adene umbɔ atsu ufai ra abi uvau, na akpoi abika arhika.
Ubinkutsu, awu ubinkpi Unum aka abee nukpɔ, umbi akorhe iyiki ize ngge itsú aguge aneke irherha arherhe ida ihwihwɛngmbɔ.
Àka asei isei ru nyaka abika afɔn, bɔr àka niba anyangu ififɔn atsirmbi iyiki ibewe, bɔr àka asei ru nyaka agãrhã Unum.
Àka adzowe undzumu imor ru ubɛn unera, àka abemu ukpui abika adɔsa, àka agũ iwei Unum na adzowe imor ru uyɛrhe.
Umbi agãrhã, àka adɔsa arherhe ateiyambi ri idzowe undzumu imor, niba iwengge ra ateiya abi amɛn aka aze nu ididɔɔr ukpekũ, bɔr ikɛi nggu abi amɛn aka atsoo.
Unera aba abimunga ri igũ ighong ayetnum aka ada irhika, na ahwɛnga Unum, awu ubin ukpoi.
Bɔr umbɔ aba akwɛr umbi ra avaumbi, ibibimambi iwu use? Bɔr umbi aba ahwa ayetnum ri ikorhu iyiki ize na abima, awu ibibemu Unum niyɔ.
Ubinkutsu ayisa umbi ri ikpũ akɛrɛ ha, Ukiristo ahwa ayetnum ri itsimbi na aneka umbi utsĩndĩwi umbi aka idɔsa adaknga.

content.text: na asi irherhunga igbɛrangwĩ ra angwĩnga.>>

content: Ivangyɛ umbɔ aka arhena unga, unga asi irhena afasa, ivangyɛ unga aka ahwa ayetnum, asi ifasa. Bɔr unga atsu amɛnnga ru uwuku uvarhe arherhe idzidzɛrhe.
Unga nibikanga atsã arhimmɛn ri iyornga ni igãrhãmau ucucii, ngge ima itsu amɛnmɛn aki arhim akpe nu umɛn ĩbɛk ri irhirhika, ru ubok isɔɔnga umbi akpo ikikerhe.
Umbi aka agwirmbi ru nyaku ídɔi, bɔr icɛrɛ umbi aka abambi ru uner ughãwã nu uwuku udzɛu ipfumbi.
